Sam (CEO): quick weekly heartbeat \u2014 3 items + metrics. please react if blocking.
Sam (CEO): 1) Policy: hosted API default data retention -> 90 days. Priya/Hana to finalise customer copy by Fri COB.
Sam (CEO): 2) Private GA: internal rollout planned next Wed; external pilot invites week after. product+eng confirm onboarding checklist green by Mon EOD.
Sam (CEO): 3) Reliability: staging canary showed a memory leak in continuous-batching; rollback done, no prod impact. SRE+eng to postmortem and action items.
Sam (CEO): Metrics: p50 down ~11% WoW; p95 up ~6% (long tail). cost/token -2%. aim to reduce p95 variance.
Priya - VP Product: ack. I'll draft retention FAQ and the GA outreach paragraph; Hana please review legal phrasing.
Diego - Eng Lead: PRs out for telemetry flag and batching fix. staging redeploy planned tomorrow AM. will add kv-cache healthchecks.
Morgan (SRE): incident brief posted in #incidents. rollback at 02:05 UTC to tag v1.23.x. postmortem Thu 15:00 UTC. runbook updated.
Alex - Head of Sales: noted on GA timeline. I'll prep a 1-paragraph outreach and share Mon noon.
Hana (Legal): suggested wording: "Default retention 90 days; extended retention via contract." will post redlines Thu AM.
deploy-bot: rollback executed by Morgan (SRE) at 02:05 UTC. log: "ROLLBACK: MEM_PRESSURE_DETECTED"
Sam (CEO): two asks: A) surface any GA blockers by Mon 09:00 PT; B) if on postmortem list and can't attend, add notes to the doc.
Sam (CEO): thanks team ":thumbsup:"
__comments: Single-thread Slack conversation; messages are short and chronological. No title field per agents.md.
